notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: Hybrid sliding/global stack with KV-cache sharing, so only global (full-attention) layers grow with context. config.json text_config: 35 layers, layer_types 28 sliding_attention + 7 full_attention (full at 4,9,14,19,24,29,34), num_kv_shared_layers 20 -> the last 20 layers reuse KV computed by earlier layers, leaving 15 KV-producing layers (0-14, of which 3 are full attention), num_key_value_heads 1, head_dim 256 for sliding layers, global_head_dim 512 for full layers, sliding_window 512, max_position_embeddings 131,072. Per-token growth = 2 (K+V) x 3 full layers x 1 KV head x 512 global_head_dim x 2 bytes (bf16) = 6,144 B/token. The 12 unique sliding layers add 2 x 1 x 256 x 2 = 1,024 B/token each but only across the trailing 512-token window (12,288 B/token x 512 = 6.29 MB fixed), so they do not scale with context. Ignoring the KV-sharing deduction the same config would give 7 full layers = 14,336 B/token; 6,144 is the config-faithful figure. REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card confirms every claimed row. All 7 rows match card table's Gemma 4 E2B column (MRCR v2 8 needle 128k avg).
